_comment: Ratings are hand-authored for HALF-COURT 1v1, not copied from 2K. Playmaking is worth zero here, help defense is worth zero, rim protection is worth less than in 5-on-5, and on-ball defense is worth much more. Each player is rated at their PEAK season. Scale is 1-99. Amend freely: the sim reads these numbers and nothing else.

_slots.sc: SHOT CREATION - getting a shot off against a set defender AND making it. Separation, shot difficulty tolerance, conversion.
_slots.hnd: HANDLES - ball security under ball pressure, beating a hand-check, change of direction.
_slots.frm: FRAME - height, length and strength together. Post leverage, contest radius, finishing through contact, rebounding.
_slots.def: DEFENSE - on-ball 1v1 defense. Containment, active hands, contest, blocking drives.
_slots.ath: ATHLETICISM - first step, burst, vertical, lateral quickness, conditioning.
